summary.en: AIIB held its 11th Annual Meeting in Doha, Qatar, in late September 2026, its first since Zou Jiayi became president, and chose Azerbaijan to host in 2027.
summary.zh: 亞投行2026年9月底於卡達杜哈舉行第11屆年會，為鄒加怡出任行長後首次年會，並決定2027年由亞塞拜然主辦。

question.en: Why do development banks rotate annual meetings among member countries?
question.zh: 開發銀行為何要在成員國之間輪流舉辦年會？

title.en: Target: about US$20 billion a year by 2030
title.zh: 目標：2030年每年融資約200億美元

summary.en: AIIB's president said the bank aims to roughly double annual financing to about US$20 billion by 2030 to help close the infrastructure funding gap.
summary.zh: 亞投行行長表示，目標在2030年前將年度融資約翻倍至200億美元，以縮小基礎建設資金缺口。

question.en: How can a development bank lend more without risking its credit rating?
question.zh: 開發銀行如何在不損及信用評等下擴大放款？

text.en: Xi Jinping proposes an Asian infrastructure bank
text.zh: 習近平提議成立亞洲基礎設施銀行

text.zh: 於北京開業，57個創始成員

text.zh: 承諾融資與《巴黎協定》目標一致

text.zh: 北京第10屆年會，成立十週年
